_comment: ACCEPTANCE WORKFLOW: 30-minute multi-speaker file in one pass. POST as {"input":{"workflow": <this object minus _comment keys>}}. Speaker turns are tagged [1]..[4] in the text; VibeVoice models turn-taking only and CANNOT overlap speech, so two people talking at once must be two runs mixed downstream. Replace the text with the real script; the sample below is short on purpose so a smoke test costs seconds, not an hour.
_save_node: SaveAudioMP3 is marked DEPRECATED in current ComfyUI in favour of SaveAudioAdvanced, but it is the right choice on a pinned base: worker-comfyui 5.10.0 fixes a ComfyUI version, and the older node is certainly present there while SaveAudioAdvanced may not be. Revisit on the next base-image bump - if a graph ever 400s on this node, swap to SaveAudio (FLAC, never deprecated) rather than guessing at the newer name. quality options are exactly: V0, 128k, 320k.
_openers_warning: Do NOT begin a script with 'Welcome to', 'Hello' or 'However'. VibeVoice was trained on un-denoised podcast audio and those broadcast-opener phrasings make it hallucinate background music. So does any reference audio with music under it. There is no parameter that disables this - it is input-side only. See DECISIONS.md Part 1.
_output_format: MP3 at 320k rather than FLAC: a 30-minute FLAC is ~150MB and base64 inflates it ~33%, which exceeds Runpod's sync response limit. For archival masters set BUCKET_ENDPOINT_URL on the endpoint and switch node 2 to SaveAudio (FLAC), which then returns an S3 URL instead of inline bytes.
